question: Where can I get cadastral parcel boundaries (geometry) for all of France, with parcel identifier and area, as a bulk download or as a queryable service?

answer.summary: Open vector parcel boundaries with parcel ID (id/idu) and fiscal area (contenance in m²) are published under Licence Ouverte v2.0 across 96 metro depts, 5 DROMs (incl. Mayotte), 977 & 978 (~94.7M parcels; Strasbourg included since Sept 2025, 0 TIFF sheets left). Bulk datasets live on Cadastre Etalab (cadastre.data.gouv.fr: 21.45 GB cadastre.parquet or per-dept GeoJSON/SHP; geojson/france/ lacks parcels), DGFiP EDIGÉO, and IGN .7z; query APIs are IGN WFS 2.0.0 and API Carto. Autonomous COMs (975, 986, 987, 988) fall outside national PCI: 987 DXF lacks area, 988 serves centroids only, 975 uses WMS/SPA, 986 lacks unified cadastre.
main_caveats: Etalab geojson/france/ and shp/france/ contain NO parcels (communes/sections/feuilles only); use cadastre.parquet (21.45 GB) or per-department files.
Géoplateforme /wfs/ows?REQUEST=GetCapabilities returns JMX metrics instead of XML; call /wfs?SERVICE=WFS&VERSION=2.0.0&REQUEST=GetCapabilities for caps, then /wfs or /wfs/ows for GetFeature.
API Carto OpenAPI YAML omits idu & contenance though live JSON returns both; Paris/Lyon/Marseille require commune INSEE (e.g. 75056) + code_arr (101), not 75101.
4 overseas collectivities (975 SPM, 986 Wallis, 987 Polynésie, 988 NC) are excluded from national DGFiP PCI: NC publishes centroids only, Polynésie 2022 DXF lacks area.
Fiscal/illustrative geometry only (Napoleonic sheets EMQ 0.5-5m; excludes domaine non cadastré public roads/rivers/shores & 29083/29084; some null contenance).
answer.confidence_reason: Verified live downloads (GeoJSON, SHP, GeoParquet S3 Range footer, Atom .7z), both query APIs (WFS, API Carto), DGFiP/IGN PDF specs, and all 4 overseas collectivity portals on 2026-11-15.

attributes.note: Open polygons cover metropolitan France, DROMs, 977/978; Polynesia adds DXF. Other COMs and excluded communes prevent complete national vector coverage.
attributes.gap_note: The imported geographic-coverage row records incomplete polygons in 975/986/988 and excluded communes 29083/29084; national PCI excludes autonomous COMs.

attributes.note: IDU is available in national PCI; autonomous territories use local identifiers or detached DXF labels. Coverage and usable joins vary.
attributes.gap_note: National PCI excludes autonomous COMs. Polynesian labels are detached DXF text and New Caledonia provides NICs on centroids; the inherited evidence does not establish complete polygon-linked IDs nationwide.

attributes.note: PCI has fiscal contenance in m² with some nulls; New Caledonia has areas on centroids. Polynesian DXF lacks area; nationwide completeness is not established.
attributes.gap_note: The original area and geographic-coverage rows document null contenance values and missing area in Polynesian DXF. Geometry-derived area was not supplied as a tested substitute.

attributes.note: Bulk parcel data is available for national PCI coverage; autonomous COMs have incomplete, different or unavailable bulk products.
attributes.gap_note: The original bulk-access row is qualified by the separate geographic-coverage row; all-France polygon, identifier and area bulk coverage was not demonstrated.

attributes.note: IGN WFS and API Carto query PCI parcels; New Caledonia provides centroids. No tested polygon query service covers every French territory.
attributes.gap_note: IGN query APIs cover PCI territories; overseas sources in the original evidence do not provide equivalent polygon queries across all autonomous COMs.

local_terms.meaning: Authoritative DGFiP vector cadastral map (598,788 sheets; 100% vectorized since Dec 2025).
14-char parcel ID: CODE_DEP (2) + CODE_COM/CODE_ARR (3) + COM_ABS (3) + SECTION (2) + NUMERO (4).
MAJIC fiscal parcel area in m² (tax surface, not necessarily identical to geometric polygon area).
Unparcelled public domain (public roads, rivers, sea shores, state canals) excluded from parcel polygons (BOI-CAD-DIFF-10).
Mise À Jour des Informations Cadastrales — DGFiP literal database supplying contenance; owner data excluded from open data.
CRPA Art. L321-4 & Décret 2017-331 framework mandating free open publication of reference data incl. PCI.
Overseas Departments-Regions (971-974, 976, inside PCI) vs Overseas Collectivities (975, 986, 987, 988 manage registers separately, except 977/978 inside PCI).
